data.title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – overdue vehicle inspection, €92.00
data.summary: The Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven's Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice against Fenja Musterwolde for driving on 1 October 2026 with a vehicle inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) more than four months overdue. It sets a fine of €60.00 plus fees totalling €92.00 and adds 1 point to the driving register; the notice was delivered on 23 November 2026.
data.explanation: This official notice (Bußgeldbescheid) fines you €92.00 in total (€60.00 fine plus fees) for driving with an overdue vehicle inspection, and adds 1 point to your driving record. You can accept it or file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows the deadline based on the delivery date on the envelope. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and the €92.00 is due two weeks after that — by the deadline shown. If you think the inspection was not actually overdue, you may want legal advice before the objection deadline passes.
